purpose: Traceable registration plan for transferring semantic hand regions from PALM/MANO into the NIH reference hand without inventing mesh IDs.
registrationSteps: Load PALM 3D scan and its supplied MANO registration.
Load the NIH 3DPX-017237 reference mesh and preserve its original geometry IDs.
Establish a rigid or similarity transform from the PALM/MANO coordinate frame to the NIH reference frame using source-supported landmarks.
Transfer MANO semantic region labels to the registered surface only when correspondence quality passes the configured QC threshold.
Persist the resulting transform, source frame, target frame, landmark set, error metrics and provenance.
Write target geometry IDs only after the correspondence has been independently verified.

currentResult.reason: Repository contains no verified PALM scan-to-NIH registration result yet; no geometry IDs are inferred.
